business_problem: Novo Nordisk needed a better way to support clinical trial data democratization and generative AI for faster drug development because clinical data lived across fragmented systems, which slowed collaboration, limited secondary research, and delayed AI-driven trial optimization.
solution_summary: Novo Nordisk uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support clinical trial data democratization and generative AI for faster drug development. The implementation replaced a legacy state where clinical data lived across fragmented systems, which slowed collaboration, limited secondary research, and delayed AI-driven trial optimization. Clinical trial data and patient demographics move through Spark Declarative Pipelines and land in shared lakehouse datasets, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL, Model Serving, and Genie operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver trial design insights and cohort selection guidance.
business_outcome: Novo Nordisk improved clinical trial data democratization and generative AI for faster drug development with measurable results including 20% of the team uses clinical data, $157M+ in net new value, and $14M in operational efficiency gains, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
